OX Trade 24oz (0.68kg) rubber mallet designed as a professional trade tool for precise striking, shaping, and moulding of various materials. The mallet is ideal for joinery, plumbing, and general construction tasks where a softer impact is required. Features an innovative dual hardness strike face, with a 65mm diameter; the black side allows for general work and the white side provides delicate, mark-free tapping on decorative surfaces such as laminate or tiles. The ergonomically designed fibreglass handle features a TPR soft-grip, providing enhanced comfort and control during prolonged use for efficient project completion.
